extensionDescription.message: Syncs the subscriptions and watch history of the YouTube account signed in in this browser into a Viyu profile. Your YouTube cookies stay in the browser.

pairHelp.message: In Viyu, open Sources, then “Pair an extension” on the YouTube card, and paste the pairing code here.

unpairConfirm.message: Unpair this extension from Viyu? What was already synced stays in Viyu.

syncSummary.message: $1 subscriptions on YouTube: $2 added, $3 removed. History: $4 added, $5 updated.

privacyNote.message: Viyu receives channel and video identifiers only. Sync runs while YouTube is open in this browser, at most every 6 hours, or when you ask.

errorSignedOut.message: Sign in to YouTube in this browser, then sync again.

errorYoutubeUnavailable.message: YouTube could not be read. Try again in a moment.

errorUnpaired.message: This extension is no longer paired with Viyu. Pair it again.

errorPairingInvalid.message: This pairing code is invalid or has expired. Create a new one in Viyu.
